# Reservatior

AI-native Residential Real Estate Market Infrastructure Platform

Reservatior is a comprehensive real estate platform that combines AI-powered property search, automated valuations, virtual staging, and smart home integration. Built for property managers, hosts, agents, and investors across 20+ countries.

## Core Features

- AI Property Search with natural language queries
- Neural Property Valuations using machine learning
- Virtual Staging and interior design generation
- Smart Home IoT integration and monitoring
- Automated Booking and reservation management
- Commission and payout automation
- Multi-language support (20 languages)
- Multi-currency and multi-region support
